objective: Turn the desk from a scanner into a realized-execution trading system over multiple runs without destabilizing the fast path.

phases.rollout_rule: Optimal prices are advisory for unproven spreads and receive allocation authority only after Phase-1 persistence validation clears. GP-per-slot-hour uses probability-weighted realized-cycle economics rather than raw spread.

phases.entry_condition: Phase 2 has accumulated multiple relay cycles and the persistence engine has promoted markets into active-slot observations.
phases.rollout_rule: The opportunity book records deduplicated relay observations immediately. Minimum absolute-profit hurdles require at least 12 relay cycles and 50 evaluated candidates before authority review; repeatability authority also waits for a materially larger user-confirmed execution sample.
Measurement is active immediately. Attention and capital-rotation decisions remain advisory until explicit inputs and realized execution samples clear configured thresholds.

phases.entry_condition: Cached catalyst_state and probability models are available and market_universe is fresh enough to price configured candidates.
phases.rollout_rule: Speculative parks remain completely separate from the normal capital frontier. Cash competes with every candidate. Positions require explicit thesis, invalidation, patient entry, per-item sizing and correlation-bucket caps. Promotion to allocation authority requires user-confirmed realized evidence and an explicit later decision.

phases.entry_condition: Confirmed position quantity and basis, a fresh usable RuneLite packet with one-hour anchors, and either a configured realized catalyst or an extreme after-tax gain.
phases.rollout_rule: Evaluate exits before new deployment. Static runtime ratings cannot suppress a dynamic exit. Thin tape requires patient staged limits and conservative references rather than an indiscriminate market sell or a blanket hold.

migration_rule: Later phases consume Phase-1 execution/persistence and Phase-2 price/slot outputs instead of creating parallel scoring systems. New entry-ranking features are observed before receiving authority; deterministic portfolio risk controls may be activated after fresh-data gates and regression tests pass.
